name: SizeBasedArena<T,N> (Orc Tribe size-based bump arena)
listed_description: Class-level operator new/delete overloads backed by one upfront malloc block of N objects of one size; allocation is a pointer bump under a std::mutex, deallocation is a no-op, no memory reuse. Companion code is in the chapter10 directory.
claim_text: Homemade operator new took 76.4% of standard-library time and operator delete 8.03% (Meyers singleton); global singleton made delete a no-op.
book_benchmark: Allocate then destroy 1,000,000 16-byte Orc objects, single thread, std::chrono timing in microseconds, one run, online gcc 15 at -O2, CPU not stated. Baseline is the standard library operator new/delete. new: 23433 us standard, 17906 us Meyers-singleton arena, 17573 us global-singleton arena. delete: 7943 us standard, 638 us Meyers, 0 us global. Reuse of freed memory is not supported, so not like for like.
found_in: book: C++ Memory Management (2025), ch. 10 Arena-Based Memory Management and Other Optimizations, sections 'Looking at the numbers' and 'Generalizing to SizeBasedArena<T,N>'

name: ChunkSizedAllocator<N,Sz...> (chunked fixed-size-class pool)
listed_description: Variadic-template pool that preallocates N blocks for each of several size classes (rounded up to powers of two) and serves class-level operator new overloads under a std::mutex; academic example, no memory reuse. Companion code is in the chapter10 directory.
claim_text: Chunked version ran in 12,032 versus 13,360 for the standard version, about 90.05% of the standard library time.
book_benchmark: 300,000 allocations (100,000 each of 30-, 60- and 100-byte objects) then destroy and deallocate through std::function, microseconds, one run, online gcc 15 at -O2, CPU not stated. Baseline is standard operator new/delete. The upfront pool allocation in the constructor is not timed. The book warns locking the mutex strongly affects the gain and deallocate locking would likely erase it.
found_in: book: C++ Memory Management (2025), ch. 10 Arena-Based Memory Management and Other Optimizations, sections 'Chunked pools' and 'Testing ChunkSizedAllocator'
